scenes.title: The Celebrity Jury and a Phone Call
scenes.summary: Dmitry Nagiyev introduces the celebrity jury for the second round of the cooking show until Viktor Barinov's ringing phone ruins the take and sparks an argument on set.

scenes.title: A Fatal Mistake at the Bar
scenes.summary: At the bar, Denis tells Kostya the details of his erotic dream about Vika on the office couch, not realizing that Katya has walked up behind him and thinks the story is real.

scenes.title: An Absurd Rumor
scenes.summary: After Katya insults Vika in the corridor, Vika confronts Denis and is outraged to learn that Katya thinks they slept together because Denis blabbed about his dream at the bar.

scenes.title: Ainura's Disservice
scenes.summary: Denis brings Katya into the kitchen so Kostya can confirm he was only recounting a dream, but Ainura chimes in claiming she saw Denis and Vika together on the windowsill.

scenes.title: An Uninvited Guest with Whisky
scenes.summary: Dmitry Nagiyev shows up at Viktor Petrovich's apartment with an expensive bottle of whisky, pretending he wants to reconcile when he actually plans to get Barinov too drunk to compete.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: The Drunken Flowerpot
scenes.summary: Pretending to drink with Nagiyev, Viktor Petrovich secretly dumps every glass of whisky into a potted plant until a heavily intoxicated Nagiyev smells the alcohol in the flowerpot.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: A Bump on the Forehead
scenes.summary: Arriving on set the next morning with a huge bump on his forehead hidden under a hat, Nagiyev assumes Barinov is drunk at home until Viktor Petrovich walks in fresh and ready.

scenes.title: The Camera in the Office
scenes.summary: When Denis begs Vika to help prove his innocence to Katya and Senya overhears the rumor, Vika remembers that her office security camera records continuously.

scenes.title: The Hidden Camera Recording
scenes.summary: After the elimination tournament montage on stage, Vika and Denis search yesterday's security footage in the office and copy the video proving Denis jumped out the window alone.

scenes.title: Proof of Innocence
scenes.summary: Denis blocks the locker room door until Katya agrees to watch the office security video on his tablet, proving beyond doubt that nothing happened between him and Vika.

scenes.title: Calling Dad
scenes.summary: Katya calls her father Viktor Petrovich on the phone to admit that Denis did not cheat on her with Vika and asks if she should forgive him.

scenes.title: German's Return
scenes.summary: Because food critic Kochetkov was injured on set, Nagiyev brings back Barinov's nemesis German Land as a guest judge for the finale, and German reveals he bought the Riga fight video.

scenes.title: Sold Dirt
scenes.summary: Viktor Petrovich explodes at Senya and Fedya for selling German the Riga video without making a backup copy, and when he tries to quit the show, Nagiyev threatens him with a huge contract fine.

scenes.title: A Strike in the Finale
scenes.summary: Forced by his contract to appear on camera, Viktor Petrovich stands at his cooking table reading a newspaper and refuses to cook while Nagiyev fumes.

scenes.title: Viktoriya Orlova's Threat
scenes.summary: Jury member Viktoriya Orlova, president of the Russian Restaurateurs Association, warns Viktor Petrovich that if he ruins the show, she will blacklist him from every restaurant in Moscow.

scenes.title: A Daughter's Words and a Gift
scenes.summary: Katya inspires her father not to give up by telling him how much she admires his culinary genius, and hands him the tablet containing the compromising video of Nagiyev and Oksana.

scenes.title: A Defender in a Cast
scenes.summary: Outside the service entrance, Denis defends Katya from two aggressive strangers despite having his arm in a cast, and Katya forgives him as she tends to his split lip.

scenes.title: Fair Play
scenes.summary: Viktor Petrovich shows Nagiyev the office security video of Nagiyev's embarrassing tryst with finalist Oksana, but then melts the flash drive in the microwave because he wants a clean victory.

scenes.title: Choosing with the Heart
scenes.summary: In the grand finale vote, German votes for Oksana and Viktoriya Orlova votes for Viktor Petrovich, leaving Nagiyev to cast the deciding vote—and he chooses Oksana with his heart.

scenes.title: A New Fairy Tale
scenes.summary: While Vika learns at her doctor's appointment that her baby is healthy and Max returns to her side, Viktor Petrovich gathers his loyal cooks to unveil a brand-new restaurant.
